capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: Creates PNG files under the current Markdown file's assets folder when you paste images.
configuration.pngOptimization.descriptio: Controls whether pasted PNG images are optimized before saving.
configuration.pngOptimization.lossless: Recompresses PNG data and removes non-visual metadata. Pixel output is preserved, and the original file is kept when optimization is not smaller.
configuration.pngOptimization.none: Saves PNG data exactly as received from VS Code.

error.readPngData: Couldn't read PNG data from the clipboard.
extension.description: Paste Markdown images into assets with automatic lossless PNG optimization to keep screenshots smaller.
paste.title: Paste image to assets
